description: Source code for quarantine management in jemalloc, including functions for initializing, growing, draining, and cleaning up quarantine buffers used for memory cleanup during thread shutdown.

methods.name: quarantine_init
methods.description: Initializes a quarantine structure with a specified maximum number of objects.

methods.name: quarantine_grow
methods.description: Grows the quarantine ring buffer by increasing its size.

methods.name: quarantine_drain_one
methods.description: Removes one object from the quarantine buffer, freeing its memory.

methods.name: quarantine_drain
methods.description: Drains objects from the quarantine buffer until a specified size limit is reached.

methods.name: quarantine
methods.description: Adds a pointer to the quarantine buffer, possibly triggering draining or growth.

methods.name: quarantine_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the quarantine buffer during thread shutdown, handling reincarnation states.
